description: This file defines the AppShellComponent, an Angular standalone component that serves as the main layout for the application, including navigation headers, sidebars, footer, and router outlet for dynamic content. It interacts with NgRx store for UI state management such as dark mode and sidebar collapse state.

classes.name: AppShellComponent
classes.description: Main layout component providing top navigation, side navigation, footer, and content projection via router-outlet. It manages UI theme and sidebar state through NgRx store.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets the current year for footer display.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Dispatches an action to toggle the application's theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Dispatches an action to toggle the sidebar's collapsed/expanded state.
